_doc: The bones a rigid gear component's one blend of weights may use, by slot (tools/armor/gear_fit.py rigid_blend). A rigid component (a plate, its rivets) never bends: it takes one blend, B's skin weights averaged over its bound points. That mean takes in every bone her skin there follows (the breast springs, the neck, the clavicle under a cuirass), and the whole plate then swings with each. Here each slot names the roles its plates may ride ("ride") and each role's share of the blend: a number is a fixed share; "mean" is the share that role already has in the mean. With "one_bone" each role's share goes to its strongest bone in the mean (a plate on one bone moves rigidly; a blend of two turning bones shrinks and shears it), else bones keep their proportions from the mean; a role the mean does not reach rides its anchor bone ("{s}" the side the mean leans to). Bones are given roles by the first pattern they match (regex, whole name). A slot not listed keeps the mean as it is. A new slot or a new body's bones need only this file. "standoff" (a slot's stand-off law): its plates stand off her where her skin measurably rises under them as she moves (tools/armor/gear_standoff.py measures each plate vertex's target clearance over the clips; gear_fit build clears each rigid component to its targets, each held at "cap_mm"; "margin_mm" over the measured need), and the tuck under them (gear_tuck's rule under a rigid plate) is full within "tuck_full_mm", none past "tuck_zero_mm", rising at most "tuck_step" a skin edge in from the edge of the skin it covers. "worn_rest" (a slot names a spring group; the top-level "worn_rest" names the springs file and its body row): that slot's rigid components are made to measure for her body AS WORN under the piece, not for the bare bind (tools/armor/worn_rest.py: the piece's hold gives her support, which rests her springs elsewhere, a push-up lifts each breast's tip about 20 mm, and sets her form_support shapes; a plate that rides the spine does not follow by itself). A piece with no hold, a body without those bones: nothing changes.
